evals.prompt:
I need you to implement this approved user story in our NextJS monorepo:

Story: As a shopper, I want to see a meaningful 'Product Not Found' page when I navigate to an invalid or discontinued product URL, so that I understand the product is unavailable and can continue shopping.

Acceptance Criteria:
- When a product SKU is invalid, unpublished, or out-of-market, the page renders a ProductNotFound component instead of the PDP
- The ProductNotFound component displays a message and a link back to the homepage
- The page returns an HTTP 404 status
- Existing valid product URLs are unaffected

Story Points: 3

The repo is at ~/projects/storefront-monorepo. The relevant package is apps/web.
evals.expected_output: The skill should: (1) ask 1-2 clarifying questions about missing context (Confluence links, related files), (2) research the monorepo structure and existing patterns, (3) present a structured implementation plan with specific file paths, component names, and test plan, (4) wait for human approval before writing any code

evals.prompt:
implement this story:

Story: As a customer, I want to see a visual checkout progress indicator showing which step I'm on (Cart → Shipping → Payment → Confirmation), so that I know how far along I am in the checkout process.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A CheckoutProgress component renders at the top of all checkout pages
- The current step is visually highlighted
- Completed steps show a checkmark icon
- Future steps are visually de-emphasised
- The component is responsive down to 375px width

Story Points: 5

Monorepo is at /Users/taiane/code/ecom-monorepo, package is packages/checkout. We have Confluence docs at https://confluence.mycompany.com/display/FE/Design+System+Components
evals.expected_output: The skill should: ask about any missing context, attempt to fetch the Confluence URL and gracefully handle auth failure by asking the user to paste, research the checkout package structure and existing component patterns, present a clear plan with file paths and responsive design approach, wait for approval

evals.prompt:
We just finished refining a story through story-studio and it was approved. Now implement it please.

Approved story:
Story: As a site visitor, I want to filter search results by category, price range, and in-stock status so that I can find relevant products faster.

Acceptance Criteria:
- A SearchFilters component renders in the left rail of the search results page
- Selecting a category filter re-fetches results scoped to that category via the Search API
- Price range is a dual-handle slider with min/max inputs
- The in-stock toggle defaults to off (shows all products)
- Active filters are shown as removable chips above the results grid
- Filter state is reflected in the URL query params so the page is shareable
- Removing all filters resets to the unfiltered result set

Story Points: 8
evals.expected_output: Since this comes from story-studio context (no repo specified), the skill should ask for the monorepo path and relevant package before doing anything else. Then research patterns, present a detailed plan covering state management (URL params), component breakdown, API integration, and test plan. Must wait for human approval.
